summary: Shapiro's 30-year pro-Israel editorial record, highlighted by AEI in 2024, frames his Gaza positions around supporting Israel and a two-state solution. In 2025 he accused Israel of overreaching, condemned civilian starvation, and called for Gaza civilians to receive food and dignity, while attributing the crisis to Netanyahu personally. In May 2026 he framed criticism of AIPAC as potentially antisemitic and warned of 'very dangerous' efforts to target AIPAC supporters within the Democratic Party.
